si.t: A practical planning tool to organise your PR application documents, track readiness, and identify gaps — NOT a prediction of approval.
• PROFILE — capture your background details (years in SG, employment, family status, etc.) for quick reference.
• DOCUMENT CHECKLIST — list every required and supporting document, mark status (Done / Missing / N/A), add notes.
• READINESS SCORE — automatic tally of required items vs completed, with a simple status indicator.
• ACTION PLAN — auto-generates a prioritised list of missing items with recommended actions.
STEP 1 · Go to PROFILE and fill in your details.
STEP 2 · Go to DOCUMENT CHECKLIST. For each item, set Status to Done / Missing / N/A and add notes.
STEP 3 · Review READINESS SCORE and ACTION PLAN. Focus on high-priority missing items first.
WHAT IS OFFICIAL vs PLANNING GUIDANCE vs USER INPUT
• Official requirements: ICA PR document checklist (identity, employment, income, family, tax, education).
• Planning guidance: common supporting documents applicants typically prepare (cover letter, testimonials, etc.).
• User input: your Profile details, Status selections, and Notes — entirely controlled by you.

This tool is for document organisation and readiness tracking only. It does NOT predict or guarantee PR approval. ICA assessment criteria are not public; always verify latest requirements on the ICA website before submission.
Yellow = editable input · Green = auto-calculated · Do not type into green cells.
